full_page.content:
1932, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 26 Cont.
Mar. 12 Marcell Vianene - 9 - spinal maningitis a year last month, got well but lost hearing completely. Just recently he seems to be & improving - hearing a neighboring whistle.
John Rudolph operation at 3 To-day Binge Family - trouble ... Mrs. Irene McCauley - nervous break-down Spinal Maningitis - 2 cases Mrs. Gr. Davis - Husband drinking and running around "with bad Co." Walter W. Dvarnick - decorator - half paralyzed 7 years Mrs. Mary Dupon - 36 - St. Clair Shores - curveture of spine - fears operation.
Page 27 March
Mrs. Gordan's Sister Margaret
John Pomatteau - 34 - Heart-trouble - Enlargement of liver - kidney badly swollen feet-sick or sickly about 1 yr.
Mrs. Margaret Dr. Blouw - Inward Goiter Columbus Raulo - loosing mind - paralisis in 1917 John Rudolph 3 - prayed for two weeks ago as being operated on - no operation +
Page 28 March Mrs. Agnes Moffit - Heart trouble Mrs. Anna Givei - non c. arthritis - four years in bed. Dr. Bacques Wife - gall stones, pernicious enemia, and etc etc. fears operation! !! !
Family Troubles - financial etc, etc, etc.
Fractured Skull 2 week (or 3) last Monday-Fractured skull - thanks for prayers quite
